about.title: About me
about.subtitle: A closer look at my journey and my passion for technology.
paragraphs: I'm a Full Stack Developer who builds web applications, systems and websites, taking care of both the logic and data and the interface.

Before moving into development, I worked as a Data Analyst, organizing and interpreting information with Power BI. That experience shaped how I approach software: understand the problem and the data before writing the first line of code.

I'm currently pursuing a degree in Software Engineering and bring what I study about architecture, quality and best practices into my daily work, with a particular interest in efficient, scalable and maintainable applications.
